calls.video_title: ServiceNow Stock: Buy the Dip? | NOW Stock Analysis
calls.price_at_call: DCF fair value ~$143; current market price not extractable from captions (garbled); forward PE just under 22
calls.thesis: BUY — post-results plunge is a buying opportunity; RPO +22% to $29.7B slightly ahead of revenue growth, AI ACV $1.7B (+70% YTD).
calls.base_case: EPS growth ~24.5% expected, above the forward PE multiple; revenue growth sustainable around current levels.
calls.bull_case: ServiceNow becoming the enterprise 'control tower' for AI; agentic AI consumption/production up 13x YoY.
calls.bear_case: Pedestrian operating cash flow growth ($839M vs $813M); $9B+ acquisition yet to show clear growth payoff.

calls.video_title: This ‘Always’ Happens to Stocks in a Midterm Year (It’s Happening Again Now)
calls.thesis: Guest Mark Chaikin: BUY reiterated (was BUY on 2026-09-30 in his last MarketBeat appearance; no flip). ServiceNow is breaking out to a new 6-month high after an analyst upgrade, up ~6.5-7% on the day AI names fell; it consolidates customer-support/workflow systems at large companies and cannot easily be replaced, and its business is mostly corporate, not government.
calls.base_case: AI is being integrated into ServiceNow's own product offerings rather than marginalising it; shares have not yet recovered their Dec-Jan high.
calls.bull_case: The next earnings report 'is going to open people's eyes' to what big software firms can do once they incorporate AI into their software.

calls.thesis: Chaikin: ServiceNow moved back into the bullish camp, uptrend re-established; AI integration into corporate workflow tooling seen as an AI-company story, not just software.

calls.video_title: Is This AI Stock a Massive Bubble? (ServiceNow Breakdown)
calls.thesis: Still a buying opportunity but with lower conviction than at sub-$100: slightly undervalued; $30-32B revenue target by 2030 (2x TTM $14.7B), AI revenue guide raised to $1.5B for 2026.
calls.base_case: DCF fair value $158 vs $138 = ~14% upside over 12-18 months.
calls.bull_case: SMB AI implementation services open a new growth lane bridging LLM capabilities to small business.
calls.bear_case: Fast-moving AI dynamics warrant a larger margin of safety at $140.
